Local Ollama HTTP Coding Backend

Source: R/backends.R
backend_ollama.Rd

Creates a hardened backend targeting a local or remote Ollama server (/api/chat) via httr2 with strict URL validation, bounded response sizes, structured JSON/schema constraints, and jittered backoff retries.

Usage

backend_ollama(
  model = "llama3.2",
  base_url = "http://localhost:11434",
  system_prompt = "Return only valid JSON matching the coding schema.",
  format = c("schema", "json", "none"),
  timeout = 120,
  max_retries = 2L,
  backoff_base = 1,
  max_response_bytes = 1048576L,
  options = list(),
  transport = NULL
)

Arguments

model

Default Ollama model tag (e.g., "llama3.2", "qwen2.5:7b").

base_url

Ollama HTTP/HTTPS base URL without trailing slash.

system_prompt

Optional system instruction prepended to messages.

format

Structured output constraint: "schema" (sends full JSON Schema), "json" (sends "json"), or "none".

timeout

Request timeout in seconds. Default 120.

max_retries

Maximum HTTP retry attempts on transient errors.

backoff_base

Base backoff seconds for jittered exponential retry.

max_response_bytes

Maximum allowed response payload size in bytes. Default 1048576L (1 MiB).

options

Named list of additional Ollama model options (e.g., seed, num_ctx).

transport

Optional custom transport function function(req_spec) for offline testing.

Value

An object of class c("llm_backend_ollama", "llm_backend").

Examples

b <- backend_ollama(model = "llama3.2")
b
#> 
#> ── LLM Backend (ollama) 
#> ID: ollama_a8a525ed863e
#> Model: llama3.2 | Endpoint: http://localhost:11434 | Timeout: 120s
